title: Efficient Multi-Precision Computation of Bessel Functions for Real Orders and Complex Arguments with Fortran Implementation -- Part II: The Modified Bessel Function of the Second Kind, $K_ν(z)$
summary: This paper, the second in a series, presents an efficient, self-contained algorithm for computing the modified Bessel function of the second kind, \(K_ν(z)\) for complex argument and real orders, building on Part~I (for \(I_ν\)). The method adaptively selects among analytic representations such as power series, large-\(|z|\) asymptotics, uniform asymptotics for large \(|ν|\), and numerically stable forward recurrence with region boundaries tuned for accuracy and efficiency.
